doc.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Coltrane's way of directing the band
summary: After a break, he says Trane spoke through the bell of the horn, and the 'Sun Ship' remark was rare.

story.theme_name: Playing with Coltrane and the avant-garde

blocks.x: How are we doing on time? Where are you? Okay let’s take a break we’ve gone for well over an hour.
(Elvin answering a question that is not heard)
It’s just happy. You know when someone is happy, you can feel it, and you can hear it in what he is doing.
There is documentation, at the “Sun Ship” recording you hear Trane say, “Just keep a thing going.”
I presume he is talking to you.
“Just keep a thing going”, so that’s about the kind of direction he would give?
Well you know that was a rare incident. Cause most of the time he had his mouthpiece in his mouth and he wasn’t talking at all! He would talk through the bell of the horn; that was his language.
